Benson.description: Cartoon 3D Pixar-style bunny, warm brown fur, long floppy ears, kind gentle face
Benson.audition_line: It's going to be all right, little one. [pause] You're safe here with us now. [pause] Take a deep breath — we'll figure this out together.

Ember.description: Cartoon 3D Pixar-style fox, orange-red fur, fluffy tail, warm amber eyes, kind expression
Ember.audition_line: Come here — you don't have to do this alone.

Bork.description: Cartoon 3D Pixar-style firefly, glowing abdomen, delicate wings, formal authoritative bearing
Bork.audition_line: By order of the King, this matter is closed.

Bramble.description: Cartoon 3D Pixar-style bear, sturdy brown build, gentle face, craftsman character

Luna.description: Cartoon 3D Pixar-style owl, scholarly glasses, wide expressive eyes, excitable academic personality

Grizzle.description: Cartoon 3D Pixar-style deer, sleek build, slightly shifty expression, King's scout and agent
Grizzle.audition_line: Nothing to see here. Move along. [pause] This area is restricted by order of the King. [pause] Keep walking and don't ask questions.

The King.description: Cartoon 3D Pixar-style regal king, commanding posture, crown, warm but authoritative expression
The King.audition_line: Everdale has need of you. [pause] The forest calls to those who listen. [pause] Will you answer when the kingdom asks?

Oliver.description: Cartoon 3D Pixar-style deer, warm gentle eyes, Arc 1 seeker who gives the child a magic wand
Oliver.audition_line: Something wonderful is waiting for us.

Willow.description: Cartoon 3D Pixar-style mystical character, serene expression, prophetic bearing
Willow.audition_line: The forest remembers what you forget. [pause] Listen closely, child. [pause] The old magic still flows through these trees.
